milestones.title: Correct input binary
milestones.summary: The Xbox 360 executable is verified, decrypted from the player's own disc and surveyed for recompilation.

milestones.title: Toolchain + recompile-only PoC
milestones.summary: All 72,864 functions translate to C++ with zero recompiler errors, warnings or unrecognized instructions; 242 instruction tests pass.

milestones.title: Native compilation and link
milestones.summary: The translated code compiles and links into a native arm64 app, with every import defined and no unresolved symbols.

milestones.title: Runtime initialization
milestones.summary: The runtime boots the game through kernel, file system and GPU bring-up to its first frame swap, in 10 of 10 consecutive launches.

milestones.title: First frame (rendering)
milestones.summary: The EA logos and the movies render through MoltenVK on Metal, with no unknown texture formats or dropped draws.

milestones.title: Audio, movies, input
milestones.summary: Music, movies and keyboard menus pass. Accepted with its open limitations, none of them recorded as passed.

criteria.title: Front-end music plays 5 minutes with no underruns
The intro movie plays at the correct speed
Default keyboard and controller mappings pinned by unit tests
Keyboard rebinding in Settings > Controls works and persists
Menus with a physical controller (the keyboard passed by hand)
Smoother movie frame pacing

milestones.title: First boot to free-roam / race load
milestones.summary: Saves, race loading and free-roam stability each have evidence. Open until the written new-profile route is run.

criteria.title: A new profile is created, saved, and reloads intact after a restart
A race or free-roam loads from the front end to control of the car
No deadlock or crash in 10 minutes of free-roam
The written new-profile route, with logs and the save recorded

milestones.title: Playable racing
milestones.summary: The current milestone. AI races and a full career race finish; controls, physics and frame pacing are still to verify.

criteria.title: AI opponents spawn, race and finish
A full career race finishes and its progress survives a restart
Steering, throttle, brake, handbrake, nitrous and camera on the keyboard
Vehicle physics consistent with the Xbox 360 version
A stable 30 fps or better over 10 minutes of racing
Audio in sync and no world geometry missing
The written test route, repeated 3 times

milestones.title: Polish and distribution
milestones.summary: Input profiles are built and tested; the app bundle check passes. A clean install on a fresh account is still to do.

criteria.title: Keyboard presets: WASD (the default) and Arrows
Separate keyboard and controller profiles that persist
Custom mappings, controller rebinding, switching and reset to default
Existing key bindings migrated into a profile, never dropped
Reset to default matches the M5 baseline
The unit tests run in ctest
The app bundle check (check_app.py) passes
Both presets drive the game, by hand
A clean install from a disc image on a fresh macOS account
The installer parametrized for Carbon

features.title: Recompiled to native code
features.text: 72,864 functions from the Xbox 360 executable, translated with 0 recompiler errors and structural validation passing.

features.title: Boots and renders
features.text: The game boots to its own screens; the EA logos and the movies render through MoltenVK on Metal.

features.title: Front-end music
features.text: Over 5 minutes with no underruns or gaps, in 3 of 3 runs.

features.title: Keyboard menus, audio and lip-sync
features.text: Keyboard navigation, rebinding that survives a restart, audio quality and movie lip-sync, checked by a person (hand test 2).

features.title: Career saves
features.text: A new career save (286,764 B) is written and reloads after a restart with its hash unchanged.

features.title: 15 minutes of free-roam
features.text: Free-roam after the prologue chase, 15 minutes in a row with no crash or hang (hand test 3).

features.title: A career race, won
features.text: Zone Heat 1 finished in 1st place against AI opponents; the cash and progress were still there after a restart (hand test 4).

features.title: Keyboard and controller profiles
features.text: WASD and Arrows presets, custom profiles, controller button rebinding and migration of existing bindings, in scripted runs and unit tests.

features.title: Game actions on a virtual controller
features.text: In a Quick Race: RB changes the camera, LB looks back, the right stick shifts gears, the Left Trigger reverses and Start pauses.

features.title: 48 unit tests
features.text: Every ctest entry passes on a MacBook Air M5 and an M1 Mac.

issues.title: Occasional stalls of about 1 s
issues.text: The presenter waits for a free drawable while holding the GPU queue lock. Why no drawable is free isn't known yet.

issues.title: GPU-idle stalls of 250–600 ms
issues.text: No lock wait is involved. The cause is unknown.

issues.title: Movie frame pacing
issues.text: Movies play at the right speed, but 20–28% of frames show for 1 or 3 refreshes instead of 2. Smoothing is deferred to polish.

issues.title: Physical controller not yet tested
issues.text: The virtual-controller and hot-unplug tests pass, but they don't show that a physical pad works.

issues.title: Key labels on non-Latin keyboard layouts
issues.text: Under a layout such as Myanmar, Settings > Controls draws letter keys as '?'. Binding such a key is refused safely; gameplay input is unaffected.

humanTests.title: Session 1: a new profile, both presets
humanTests.covers: The new-profile route to a race load (M6.6); WASD and Arrows driving and switching without a restart (M8.11).

humanTests.title: Session 2: restart and hand test 5
humanTests.covers: The profile reloading intact (M6.6), and which keys give handbrake, nitrous, Speedbreaker, camera and look back.

humanTests.title: Sessions 3–5: the M7 route, 3 times
humanTests.covers: Controls, physics, 10 minutes of frame times, audio and picture, on a race of at least 10 minutes (M7.1, M7.2, M7.5–M7.7).

humanTests.title: Clean install on a fresh macOS account
humanTests.covers: Installing from a disc image on a new user account (M8.4).

humanTests.title: Physical controller
humanTests.covers: Menus and driving on a real pad, once one is available. Never recorded as passed before then.

achievements.text: Keyboard presets merged: WASD is now the built-in Default that a new player starts on, beside Arrows. A player on the former WASD preset keeps those keys as a custom profile.
A reported hang after creating a new profile at boot was rechecked on two Macs and didn't reproduce: the profile is saved and the main menu follows.
Change Camera, Look Back, gear shifts, Reverse and Pause seen working in a scripted Quick Race on a virtual controller. Nitrous, Handbrake and Speedbreaker are still to verify.
ReCarbon's source and this website went public, with every page checked live: no broken links and no accessibility violations found by axe-core.
A fresh clone from GitHub rebuilds byte-identical generated code, and the instruction tests and the website build pass. A timing test was made reliable under load.
Rendering resolution re-measured on the MacBook Air M5: 1x, 1.5x, 2x and 3x frame costs recorded, and Auto picks 2x. Ultrawide and scaled 3D in gameplay are unverified.
25 unit tests ported from SpeedBreaker v0.1.8 and adapted to Carbon, each checked with planted bugs: ctest grows from 20 to 48 entries, all passing on both Macs.
The install check now stops every process it starts, on any exit, verified in five scenarios.
Keyboard and controller mappings became plain data, with the WASD and Arrows presets; no key drives two controls in Arrows.
One atomic writer now saves both the settings and the input profiles; saving settings is unchanged.
